system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Assemble a system prompt from typed blocks with a token budget, let it change across the phases of a conversation
system_prompt_style.note: build_agent takes `instructions` string; prompting subsystem composes blocks/ConversationFlow.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent finds its tools on the MCP server on its own.
env_context_strategy.note: General-purpose agent; context comes from tool calls plus optional memory/RAG injection.

context_compaction.note: Context engine and blog posts on context-window management / trim-messages imply compaction; exact default not shown in evidence.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard for connecting LLMs to tools
tool_call_format.note: LangChain BaseChatModel tool calling; code-action pattern also shipped (guides/code-action.md).

tool_count.evidence_quote:
agent = await build_agent(
 model="openai:gpt-4o-mini",
 instructions="You are a helpful assistant.",
 )
tool_count.note: Default build_agent ships no built-in tools; tools come from MCP servers you configure. Sandbox adds five tools; Open Mode adds 14 meta-tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `build_agent()` connects to your tool servers, discovers the tools on its own
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing primitive shipped by default; edits only via user-provided MCP tools or sandboxed code.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: add `@server.tool()`, and it becomes an MCP tool with a schema taken straight from your type hints
tool_schema_source.note: OpenAPI ingestion listed in MCP server features.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Promptise Foundry is MCP-native — agents auto-discover tools from any MCP server URL

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Seven presets cover common shapes — research, debate, plan-act-reflect, one-shot self-verify, write-one-program
loop_primitives.note: Default is the tool loop (react): "Most tasks run fine on the default tool loop." Runtime adds event/webhook triggers.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Most tasks run fine on the default tool loop.
planning_granularity.note: PlanAndExecute strategy and plan-act-reflect preset are opt-in.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Promptise Foundry covers single agents, multi-agent coordination via cross-agent delegation (ask_peer and broadcast over HTTP+JWT)
multi_agent_topology.note: Peer topology reachable via cross-agent config.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Cross-agent delegation via ask_peer (send a question to another agent over HTTP+JWT and await the answer)
delegation_mechanism.note: Default has no peers configured; opt-in message-style peer delegation.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Mark a tool as needing sign-off and the approval is required no matter which app calls it
human_in_loop.evidence_locator: README.md (Built for putting agents in front of customers)@816cec5
human_in_loop.note: Off by default: "off by default, on with a parameter".

short_term_state.evidence_quote: trigger queues, heartbeat monitoring, concurrency control, conversation buffer, and journaled state for crash recovery

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: ChromaProvider (local vector search, persistent), and Mem0Provider (enterprise-grade graph search). The agent auto-searches memory before every invocation
long_term_memory.note: Memory is opt-in (memory= parameter); skill registry documented at core/skill-registry.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The ReplayEngine reconstructs state from a checkpoint plus replay log. When a process crashes, it restarts from the last known good state.

self_verification.note: SelfCritique strategy and one-shot self-verify preset are opt-in; default tool loop has none.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Most tasks run fine on the default tool loop.
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry in the default loop; FallbackChain covers model failover only.

rollback.note: Journal rewind restores agent state, not filesystem; no repo/git rollback shown.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Set limits on tool calls and spend, watch for stuck or looping behavior, and require a human when it hits something risky.
termination_condition.note: Budget/health governance is runtime-level and opt-in.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Budget (tool calls, LLM turns, cost units, irreversible actions)
cost_controls.note: SemanticCache for caching; FallbackChain / per-node models for routing; all opt-in.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Middleware (logging, timeout, rate limit, circuit breaker, audit).
timeouts.note: Approval also denies on timeout; no run-level timeout found in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Docker-based sandbox with seccomp syscall filtering, capability dropping, read-only rootfs, resource limits, and network isolation.
execution_isolation.note: Default build_agent runs in-process on the host; container sandbox is opt-in via sandbox parameter.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: the ones you don't pass cost you nothing
filesystem_access.note: No filesystem restriction by default; sandbox adds read-only rootfs and path-traversal prevention.

network_policy.note: Network restriction only inside the optional sandbox; default has no egress control.

permission_model.evidence_quote: off by default, on with a parameter
permission_model.evidence_locator: README.md (Built for putting agents in front of customers)@816cec5
permission_model.note: Opt-in: capability-based access policies, per-tool permission guards, approval gates, auto-approval classifier.

tracing.evidence_quote: Eight transporters — HTML report, JSON file, structured log, console, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, webhook, callback.

replayability.evidence_quote: InMemoryJournal and FileJournal record every state transition, trigger event, and invocation result. The ReplayEngine reconstructs state from a checkpoint plus replay log.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: For MCP servers, TestClient runs the full pipeline in-process — validation, DI, guards, middleware, handler — with no network.
eval_hooks.note: Testing utilities and prompt assertions ship, but no benchmark evaluation runner is listed.

guardrails.evidence_quote: PromptiseSecurityScanner with six detection heads — DeBERTa-based prompt injection detection, PII detection (69 regex patterns), credential detection (96 patterns)
guardrails.note: guardrails= parameter is opt-in; approval gates and capability policies are the action policies.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Promptise Foundry is MCP-native — agents auto-discover tools from any MCP server URL
target_domain.note: General framework; code-review/code-action labs give some swe coverage.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Any model. Promptise Foundry is model-agnostic. Use a string like openai:gpt-5-mini, anthropic:claude-sonnet-4.5, or ollama:llama3, or pass any LangChain BaseChatModel directly.
